entries.activity: Bracken Manufacturing Co. piloted Meridian Access Platform on 400 shop-floor tablets at its Denver plant during a six-week evaluation completed in Q1 2025; device provisioning time dropped from 42 minutes to 6 minutes per unit, attributed to the bulk certificate renewal feature shipped in Device Enrollment Service v1.4. These results directly informed the company-wide 3,800-unit rollout proposal that remained under review as of late February 2025.
